تسرب مضخة الزيت 
 SPF 20
 Alweiler - Italy

This Document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
for fuel leakage oil pump on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title 
block

The first draft initiated by eng. Saad 
Samra, tested at 27 June 2003 by eng Mohamed Abd El-Azeem, revised by EDEPCo. 
eng. Abouda El-Bana, accepted by General Director eng. Mohamed Hamouda Al-Sarag, 
and approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud El-Wakeel Head Sector of Demiatta GT 
PS.
إصدار أمر العمل بما في ذلك أسماء العمل الجماعي.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the pump mechanically and electrically.

items: إصدار أمر العمل بما في ذلك أسماء العمل الجماعي.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the pump mechanically and electrically.

sections.text:
Drain the leakage oil tank by opening of the filter drain 
 cocks.

Check the leakage oil tank and refill it up to its half of the 
 content

Check the ball valve at the delivery side of the pump and 
 open.

Check the sense of pump rotation by starting the motor 
 temporality.

Check the pump starts automatically, pumps the fuel oil out of 
 the tank when the level is dropped to position pump off and stops 
 automatically.
